subject: action path ASTRA ABI tests
body:
A locked the action path in §01.7 / §05 / §20.5.1 (v1.5-candidate). Lookup != binding != command. NO_ACTION = no PrimitiveCommand. After issue: COMMAND_ACCEPTED / EFFECT_UNOBSERVED / EFFECT_OBSERVED.

B actions (do not wait to ack A):
1. §03: add ASTRA action-precheck. Inputs = ACTION_INTENT + candidate CapabilityDescriptor refs. Checks = mode/schema/generation/safety_contract/skill-executability. Outputs = action verdicts DISTINCT from query 0x01-0x06. ASTRA does not drive pins.
2. §03.1: GEMINI/Language Adapter xref is §01.8 not §01.7.
3. Safety_contract fail is ASTRA-admissible SAFETY_VETO; safety is not a second approver of what ASTRA denied. Name contract fields (limits, units, generation) in §03; packing stays implementation-defined.
4. §04: either state explicitly that ACTION_INTENT / CapabilityBinding / PrimitiveCommand / ObservedEffect are NOT UART Query/Result/SemanticEvent records, OR add distinct records. Do not pack truth or Top-K. SemanticEvent currently has no command_id.
5. §31/§32: ingest §05.8 test names (CAPABILITY_ENUM_PASS, SAFETY_VETO_PASS, COMMAND_READBACK_PASS, GEMINI_NO_ACTUATOR_AUTHORITY_PASS, UNEXECUTED_NO_CREDIT_PASS, STALE_DESCRIPTOR_REJECT_PASS). Keep X0-15 as no-hardware case.
6. Live ABI encodings remain R1 §04.12. AGENT_A worktree copy of §04 still ends at §4.11; A will not copy B-owned ABI. ManifestHeader listed 132 vs claimed 128 remains open.

Rejected as speculation: bit-packing of action objects; executor_index RTL meaning.
